title: lannea fruticosa
intro: Lannea fruticosa, commonly known as the wild plum or African plum, is a small tree or shrub species belonging to the Anacardiaceae family. The health benefits of Lannea fruticosa include its potential to lower cholesterol levels, improve digestion, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Lannea fruticosa include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
